caller_has_validator_role.meaning: the caller of the batch transfer helper holds the validator role

source_is_kyc_verified.meaning: the address whose funds are debited is marked isKycVerified

destination_is_kyc_verified.meaning: the destination (creditor) address is marked isKycVerified

kyc_guarantee_reliable.meaning: on-chain KYC transfer gating remains reliable for downstream integrators (no non-KYC destination received funds via a batch path)

assumptions: The batch transfer helper (batchTransfers or rBatchTransfers) is the checked action; either path alone suffices for the bypass.
Funds are debited from the KYC-verified source and credited to the non-KYC destination within the same batch call.
The validator is treated as the privileged caller whose batch path is the scenario under analysis.

unresolved.description: Report does not establish whether the token was paused during the batch transfer; pause bypass is a separate capability and is not part of this KYC-gating claim.
No concrete amounts or addresses are given for the moved funds; the claim is formalized at the qualitative KYC-gating level.

limitations: Formalizes only the KYC-gating reliability impact (v_regulatory_risk); pause bypass and onward routing are handled in separate passes.
The reliability observable is a qualitative Boolean because the report states no numeric definition for downstream integrator reliance.
Whether the validator is malicious in an observed transaction versus hypothetically capable is not resolved by the report.
